scope: Two original TFB datasets, all four horizons and all five original RISE seeds. Methodological fixed-default reproduction; exact TFB tuning and original curated Yahoo suite remain unresolved.
split: train=floor(.7N), test=floor(.2N), remainder validation; every label lies wholly inside its own split

unspecified_choices_frozen_without_test_.transformer_encoder_init: PyTorch standard TransformerEncoder cloning; no extra manual initialization
unspecified_choices_frozen_without_test_.scheduler: CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts T_0=10, T_mult=1, eta_min=0; step each epoch
unspecified_choices_frozen_without_test_.checkpoint: lowest validation MSE of ten epochs
unspecified_choices_frozen_without_test_.patch_positional_encoding: standard sinusoidal on patch positions; granularity embeddings zero initialized
unspecified_choices_frozen_without_test_.ARIMA: per-channel input96, order111, no drift/trend, statsmodels state-space ML maxiter50, stationarity/invertibility enforced
unspecified_choices_frozen_without_test_.random_walk_drift: per-window mean of95 input first differences
unspecified_choices_frozen_without_test_.TFB_search: Broader original grid unavailable; no grid search and no exact-replication claim.

source_data_ambiguity.native: Source-verified TFB loader row-block reconstruction:1244 NASDAQ/1243 NYSE.
source_data_ambiguity.date_complete: Explicit inner-join adaptation:1240 NASDAQ/1239 NYSE matches RISE Table1.
source_data_ambiguity.selection: Both interpretations reported; neither selected using test metrics.
source_data_ambiguity.calendar: Source date labels are numeric ordinals, not genuine calendar dates; daily market-neutral accounting is blocked.

validation_checks: training-only scaler and fixed training memory bank
all horizon labels inside train/val/test partition
returns_extension: blocked; no tradeable-asset mapping, original calendar dates or actual execution/corporate-action cashflows
test_selection: None; no adaptive changes based on test loss or return. All 128 seed/method/layout/dataset/horizon scores retained.
